answer: An AI-agent economy resists sybil attacks by forcing each agent to deposit a unique, time-locked proof-of-work receipt into a communal vault before gaining voting rights. The puzzle difficulty rises like tracking a bright comet skimming a turbulent lagoon of concurrent hash targets. This works because generating many identities requires sequential compute that an attacker cannot cheaply parallelize across free accounts, imposing a real energy and time cost that scales with the number of sybils and exceeds any single-epoch reward.
